strings.subtitle: {metric}, {encoding}. {span}.

metric.on_time: Percentage of station stops where the train arrived early or within 59 seconds
metric.t3: Percentage of station stops where the train arrived within 3 minutes
metric.t15: Percentage of station stops where the train arrived within 15 minutes

encoding.rolling: 13-period average, matching ORR's moving annual average

strings.provisionalTip: Provisional. Final figures follow one period later.

notes.axis: The vertical axis does not start at zero, so that period-to-period movement is visible.
notes.band: The shaded band is the range across operators in the same sector; the line through it is their average, weighted by recorded station stops. Sector grouping is this site's, not ORR's — Great Western Railway and East Midlands Railway each run services across more than one sector.
notes.provisional: The most recent period is provisional and shown dashed; Network Rail supplies final figures one period later.
notes.rolling: A 13-period average covers one whole rail year, so seasonal effects such as autumn leaf fall are averaged out rather than read as a trend.
notes.recency: Measured against the timetable agreed at 22:00 the previous evening, so services withdrawn earlier than that do not appear.
